svg.title: Time of the Carbon test suite with each coverage driver
svg.desc: The test suite of Carbon has 6,349 tests. It takes 18.7 seconds without a coverage driver, 19.2 seconds with turbocov (+3 %), 36.7 seconds with PCOV (+96 %) and 250 seconds with Xdebug (+1,237 %).
svg.text: Driver overhead only, without the coverage library of PHPUnit · mean of 8 rounds · PCOV 1.0.12 · Xdebug 3.5.3 · OPcache off
